messages:
mira: quick thermometer scan for late-binding + speculative on new 70B fork (quant q4_0). baseline vs spec+latebind across temps 0.2 / 0.7 / 1.0. saw weird regressions on code-gen, posting config + a couple sample outputs.

sam: which eval suites and metrics you used?

mira: GSM8K (exact), HumanEval (pass@1), XSUM (ROUGE-1). also tracking latency p50/p95 and GPU util. run sizes small now (n=200) but consistent patterns.

tess: what's the quant + KV setup? per-channel? cache unaffected?

mira: q4_0 per-row scale, weights-only quant, KV cache kept FP16. latebind enabled (defer top-k until post-candidates), speculative config: topk=40, speculative_heads=2, early_exit disabled. snippet: ```spec_config={"topk":40,"late_bind":true,"spec_heads":2}"```.

jordan: short summary of numbers?

mira: TL;DR: latency p50 ~1.8x faster on spec config. GSM8K -2% abs. XSUM ROUGE-1 -0.8 abs. HumanEval pass@1 drops ~12% at temp 0.2, ~6% at 0.7, almost neutral at 1.0.

sam: big drop on code at low temp is concerning. any sample diffs to eyeball?

mira: yes. example (prompt truncated):

Original baseline completion (temp=0.2):
```def count_pairs(nums):
    counts = {}
    for n in nums:
        counts[n] = counts.get(n,0) + 1
    return sum(v*(v-1)//2 for v in counts.values())
```

Speculative+q4_0 output (same prompt):
```def count_par( nums ):
  c = {}
  for i in nums:
    c[i] = c.get(i,0) + 1
  return sum(cnt*(cnt-1)/2 for cnt in c)
```

notice: tokenization/integer division bug and malformed aggregation.

tess: looks like token-level probs push to shorter/altered tokens and numeric ops got float op `/` vs `//`. maybe topk prunes rare tokens important for punctuation/ops.

ops-bot: perf-trace: job 2734512350: GPU util 92% spec vs 67% baseline, kernel-level time reduced on attention kernel by ~40%.

jordan: hypothesis: quantization + speculative pruning amplify brittle token probs for deterministic code tasks. at low temp model is confident but wrong; speculative selection may cut tokens that disambiguate integer ops.

sam: can we run ablation: (1) quant-only, (2) spec-only (no quant), (3) latebind-only, (4) full combo? also sweep topk [40,80,128] and spec_heads [1,2,3].

mira: queued ablation + temp sweep (n=1000 for HumanEval). will also dump logprobs and token-level alignments. deploying canary with conservative spec (topk=128, temp=0.3) to dedicated pool. deploy-bot: canary job 2734512365 queued to dedicated-1. :thumbsup:

tess: add per-output confidence threshold + fallback to baseline beam for examples where top speculative token prob < 0.02? might catch these numeric edge cases.

jordan: also add calibration check: compare model token-prob CDFs between baseline and spec+quant for HumanEval failing examples. if distribution shifts, we need probability reweighting or post-hoc rerank.

mira: agreed. I'll attach small diff logs when ablation runs finish. next checkpoint in ~6h. cc @sam @tess :eyes:
